description: PerceptionX helps employer-brand, talent-acquisition, and communications teams understand how leading AI platforms describe their organization. Explore employer perception scores, sentiment, visibility, recurring themes, cited sources, competitor mentions, market differences, and quarterly trends using the data available in your connected PerceptionX organization.

defaultPrompt: Which sources does AI cite about us in the US, and where are we missing?
Which careers-site pages are AI answers actually citing about our culture?
When candidates ask AI about pay, who gets named next to us?
